description: General enemy strength curve by enemy (encounter) level: every non-dummy enemy gets the same HP and attack multiplier for its level, starting lower at level 1 and rising along t^pow to 1.0 at ENEMY_CURVE.full. Ratios between enemy kinds, elites and bosses are preserved; no dependence on hero class, abilities or quest name. Heroes, training kit, spec unlocks and saves are unchanged.

edits.name: Define the general enemy level curve
edits.old: const elvl = ENCOUNTERS[st.encounter].level, ef = lvlFactor(elvl), gsc = groupScale(st);
edits.new:
const elvl = ENCOUNTERS[st.encounter].level, ef = lvlFactor(elvl), gsc = groupScale(st), dummy = /dummy/.test(d.ai || '') || d.hp >= 1e8;
    const chp = dummy ? 1 : enemyCurve(elvl, 'hp'), catk = dummy ? 1 : enemyCurve(elvl, 'atk');

edits.name: Apply the curve to enemy HP and attack
edits.old: maxHp: Math.round(d.hp * ef * gsc * 1.08), hp: Math.round(d.hp * ef * gsc * 1.08), atk: d.atk * ef * gsc * 1.06,
edits.new: maxHp: Math.round(d.hp * ef * gsc * 1.08 * chp), hp: Math.round(d.hp * ef * gsc * 1.08 * chp), atk: d.atk * ef * gsc * 1.06 * catk,

edits.name: Curve parameters next to the level constants
edits.old: function lvlFactor(l) { return Math.pow(LVL.growth, l - LVL.base); }

edits.name: Expose the curve for balance reports
